notes.title: HOTFIX UPDATE: Critical Issues Fixed + Performance Improvements!
notes.notes:
HOTFIX UPDATE: CRITICAL ISSUES FIXED!



FIXES INCLUDED

• Fixed soldier gun shot and some audios not playing properly
• Resolved boss characters accumulating on ground
• Fixed save file directory issues for new players
• Improved exit game stability
• Updated flamethrower soldier sound
• Balanced audio volume levels
• Tutorial boost step now auto-triggers enemy waves
• Video player system stabilization
• Updated Unity editor version
• Disabled ALT toggle info by default (press ALT to re-enable building level indicator visuals and zombie health bars)
• General performance optimizations



CONTINUED SUPPORT

We're constantly monitoring community feedback and working to improve the game experience. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please let us know through our community channels.

Your feedback drives our improvements!


WHAT'S NEXT

This hotfix addresses immediate concerns, but we're not stopping here. Our roadmap continues with Part 2 coming October 11, bringing even more improvements and new features to City Defense Z.

Stay tuned for more updates and keep the feedback coming!

Report Issues & Feedback

Official Website

City Defense Z Wiki

We're listening, we're fixing, we're improving. Your experience matters.

notes.title: Patch Rollback Due to Steam Cloud Save Issues
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/cbea22f381dac2826f17c15f728660ebd52156f7.png"]

Patch Rollback Due to Steam Cloud Save Issues

Hey everyone,

Earlier today, we released a patch as part of Developer Challenge Day 4. Unfortunately, we encountered unexpected issues with the Steam Cloud Save system that did not appear during our local testing.

To avoid further disruption, we've rolled back to the previous stable version of the game. This should restore normal functionality for all players.

We’re actively working on a fix and plan to release the corrected patch tomorrow during early working hours.

We're sorry for the inconvenience and really appreciate your patience and support.

notes.title: DAY 4/10: Hotfix Update - Enhanced Gameplay & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
DAY 4/10: HOTFIX UPDATE - ENHANCED GAMEPLAY & BUG FIXES

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/70a37470bd514d4a00e66d8a8445a2ad23f2abca.png"]
DAY 4: HOTFIX UPDATE
Today, we're releasing a comprehensive hotfix that addresses critical gameplay issues and enhances the overall player experience. These improvements ensure that when you launch into survival, everything works exactly as intended.  Polish, performance, and player experience improvements.


Every detail matters when survival is on the line

Today's update focuses on the small details that make a big difference. From visual polish to critical bug fixes, we've addressed the issues that matter most to players. When you're fighting for survival, you need every advantage - and every system working perfectly.


CRITICAL FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS


Enhanced gameplay experience with polished mechanics


Map Progression & UI Enhancements
Improved navigation and user interface

Map Transition Confirmation:
• Added "Do you want to exit?" confirmation panel when reaching Day 30 on the first map
• Prevents accidental progression and gives players control over their timing
• Seamless transition between maps with clear player choice

Enhanced Resource Management:
• NEW: Basic Soldier count now displayed in the TOP UI resource bar
• Real-time visibility of your military strength at a glance
• Better strategic planning with immediate troop information

Improved Combat Visualization:
• NEW: Radial white sprite indicators showing soldier attack ranges
 • Clear tactical information for optimal unit placement
 • Enhanced strategic depth with visible combat zones  
Combat & Visual Improvements
Polished combat mechanics and visual effects

Stonefist Stone Enhancements:
• FIXED: Random appearance issues on map locations
• NEW: Added explosion effects to Stonefist stones
• More satisfying and impactful combat interactions
• Consistent visual behavior across all map areas

Soldier Visibility Fixes:
• FIXED: Soldier shadow rendering issues
• Improved visual clarity and depth perception
• Better integration with environmental lighting
• Enhanced overall visual polish

Combat System Improvements:
• FIXED: Random bullet visual artifacts in air
• Cleaner, more consistent projectile rendering
• NEW: Population requirement notifications for Machine Gun units
• Clear feedback when resources are insufficient for unit deployment


Gameplay Mechanics & Stability
Enhanced reliability and user experience

Daytime duration has increased from 120 seconds to 240 seconds.

Card System Improvements:
• FIXED: Aircraft card spawning issues
• More consistent and reliable card distribution
• Better balance in unit availability

Reroll System Fixes:
• FIXED: Reroll button activation inconsistencies
• Reliable access to card refresh functionality
• Improved strategic flexibility

Steam Cloud Save Synchronization:
• CRITICAL FIX: Enhanced Steam Cloud save functionality
• IMPORTANT: For proper synchronization, load your save on the original device first, then access on new devices
• Reliable cross-device progress preservation
• Seamless gaming experience across multiple platforms


VISUAL POLISH & USER EXPERIENCE

Every detail refined for maximum immersion

UI Enhancements:
• Cleaner resource bar with soldier count integration
• More intuitive combat range indicators
• Improved visual feedback for all interactions

Combat Clarity:
• Fixed shadow rendering for better depth perception
• Eliminated visual artifacts that could distract from gameplay
• Enhanced explosion effects for more satisfying combat

Strategic Information:
• Real-time soldier count visibility
• Clear combat range indicators for tactical planning
• Improved notification system for resource requirements


PERFORMANCE & STABILITY

Optimized for smooth survival gameplay

Technical Improvements:
• Enhanced Steam Cloud save reliability
• Fixed visual rendering issues
• Improved UI responsiveness
• Better resource management system

Cross-Platform Compatibility:
• Reliable save synchronization across devices
• Consistent performance across different hardware
• Optimized for various screen resolutions



Stay connected, Survivors...

notes.title: City Defense Z – Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,


You’ve been waiting a long time. You played our three different demos, tested the shifting world of the game, and gave us feedback that helped take City Defense Z beyond what we ever imagined. Now this city has been rebuilt from that very first demo, keeping the core gameplay you loved but transforming it into a brand new game with a completely different challenge.



Behind the scenes, we worked through dozens of files named “FINAL,” “FINAL2,” and “ReallyFinal.” And now, we’re ready to show you what’s next.



City Defense Z launches in full on August 26th. The zombies are at the gates, and the city is counting on your command.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/15764b315d1d979597f689be5ef8a65230f16ff4.png"]



In the new rogue-lite structure of City Defense Z, every game promises a completely different journey. 

 Cards will determine your military strength, discoveries, and decisions—shaping your survival. 

Turn your city from an ordinary defense base into a living, growing world that reacts to your choices. 

Manage your citizens, soldiers, and resources to maintain that delicate balance between survival and expansion. 

Command your forces with new tools: merge soldiers to create stronger units, deploy advanced classes, and push back the ever-growing zombie threat. 

Stay up to date with breaking news. New opportunities, unexpected threats, and special situations await you in the “Breaking News” feed—the early bird wins! 

 Grow stronger after every attempt with permanent upgrades. With multiple save slots and different maps, plan your long-term strategy and turn your city into a legend. 

It’s no longer just about defense—produce the food to keep your army alive, gather resources directly from your buildings, and sustain your war effort. 

Face unpredictable challenges, from unique zombie types to massive boss encounters, and strengthen your defenses with walls. 

Meet unique NPCs, each with their own stories, personalities, and benefits. Send them on expeditions into the unknown to find rare materials and powerful rewards. 

Command your forces with new tools: merge soldiers to create stronger units, deploy advanced classes, and push back the ever-growing zombie threat.




[previewyoutube="N3BJ_6YAGH4;full"][/previewyoutube]


The countdown begins… Soon, we’ll all be counting down from 10 together. With each step, you’ll discover new content, uncover surprises, and meet a new character. Stay tuned, and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!



You can learn more about City Defense Z by visiting our official website or joining our Discord community!

notes.title: Major Content Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
City Defense Z is about to transform into an entirely new experience with its most ambitious content update yet. You may not see it in the game just yet, but a major change has begun in the city.

This update isn't just about adding new content, it breathes fresh life into the very soul of the game. Your city is no longer just a collection of blocks on a map. It’s becoming a living, breathing world that talks, gives quests, grows, and evolves alongside you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/e0d7db1cff44a3b202a5ee7fa575e7927e98d604.png"]

In addition, we now have a rogue-lite structure. Every playthrough will be a different journey, and your cards, discoveries, military power and decisions will shape that journey.

Meet NPCs and send them on expeditions. Merge your soldiers to make them stronger. Use the new card system to build your defenses wisely, seize trade opportunities and follow what is happening on the map dynamically. Because now in City Defense Z, every day, every decision and every detail matters even more. The zombies may still be coming, but you are no longer just defending.

This time there is a bit of conversation, a bit of tactics, and yes, plenty of fun.


NPC and Interaction Systems
NPC Mechanic: Various characters now arrive in your city, each offering different personalities and benefits.

Dialogue System: Interact with NPCs to gain narrative depth and gameplay advantages.

Expedition System: Send NPCs on exploration missions to earn resources and surprise rewards.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/edd6e20bc74898fb926df1cd67b7c57fd1979a11.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/4f819b703f85953914bdae2e3b7d274443bda87c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/b79fd9d278abe2eaa957a786694a9db418c40eb9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/9e9957580f27b8ba4caaff01c8b5b3873df606f3.png"]


Card and Trade Systems
Advanced Card System: New card types, special powers and combination options make your strategy truly your own.

Daily Trade: Manage your resources wisely with daily changing trade opportunities.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/1fcb348b3232c0554e09bb894813ea00fc53b3b5.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/e144f95be2b60ba2b78a5d5e49b0f3304de9ce0e.png"]


Production and Resource Systems
Farm System: Take control of producing the food that will keep your soldiers standing.

On Building Resource Gathering: Buildings are now not only for defense but also production hubs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/63327cd8278a228f4e4ba20d6df601282894f88d.png"]


Map and Visual Improvements
New Map: Defend your city in a brand new region.

Breaking News: Track dynamic events and notifications directly from the map.

Visual Effects: Enhanced effects make battles more cinematic than ever.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/8df2302e072da43b2be41cc320093367cb587f69.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/3c21c83a7eb2820bc9b85660982d7ddcd292f6dc.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/aea7c9a0c053f3af00efd6e2dee6ee471367df98.png"]
Enemy and Combat Systems
New Zombie Types: Face special zombies, each offering a different challenge.

Boss Battles: Confront massive boss enemies that will push your limits.

Barrier Walls: Create strategic defensive lines on the battlefield.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/9c991a21c6c0e554d96f75d2daed84a05926f4a7.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/252cf696d04ef50e2e3800b25c662dbcd1befbd1.png"]
Soldier and Combat Mechanics
Soldier Merge System: Combine soldiers of the same type to create stronger units.

New Soldier Types: Strengthen your defense line with advanced classes.

Improved Targeting: Aircraft now have smarter and more strategic targeting abilities.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/d624f93ca8689ba4b1c9a258aa7e20aefe12429d.png"]
Progression and Save System
Save Slots: Different maps, different strategies, different saves.

Permanent Upgrades: Long term progression with upgrades that carry over between games.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/255ec67d9a9a3d1c6ce71f9a44bd3d2b436491d9.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/f64744af936810f93304a159e019072c2a8d6e6f.png"]


UI and UX Innovations
Renewed Interface: A brand new look and improved user experience in both gameplay and menus.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/cf0d68ea85574de48d8448e3fd52d374beada6a1.png"]

We cannot wait for you to experience all these new features very soon. 🧱🧟‍♀️

Do not forget to add it to your wishlist.
